description: This file defines the IHostEnvironmentStatistics interface, which provides methods to access statistics about the hosting environment such as total physical memory, CPU usage, and available memory. It is part of the Orleans.Statistics namespace and is marked as obsolete.

classes.name: IHostEnvironmentStatistics
classes.description: An interface for accessing hosting environment statistics, including total physical memory, CPU usage, and available memory.

methods.name: TotalPhysicalMemory
methods.description: Property to get the total physical memory on the host in bytes.

methods.name: CpuUsage
methods.description: Property to get the host CPU usage percentage from 0.0 to 100.0.

methods.name: AvailableMemory
methods.description: Property to get the total available memory for allocation on the host in bytes.
